punchline: Two wasps in one burrow was not teamwork.
thirty_sec: In 1979 Jane Brockmann, Alan Grafen and Richard Dawkins tested why digger wasps share burrows. A cooperation model was rejected; a model of diggers and enterers taking over abandoned burrows fit one of two populations well.
question: In one shared piece of work, who has paid most of the cost and who has collected most of the benefit?
key_contrast: It looked like cooperation, but one wasp was exploiting the other.
